verdict.rationale: Docs confirm receipt-to-expense auto-matching via API (brex-docs-7) and AI agents that 'fetch receipts' and audit/review expenses automatically (brex-docs-15, brex-docs-16, brex-docs-23), suggesting some automated capture and nudging logic. However there is no explicit documentation of e-receipt pulls from third-party integrations (e.g., email/vendor integrations) or of a nudge system that specifically limits alerts to only genuinely missing receipts. Missing for 10: documentation of integration-based e-receipt ingestion, and specifics on smart/selective missing-receipt nudging logic.
